from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Total assets information from one company's financial statement filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="The total assets value in reported currency units")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., 'USD'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the financial statement")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of reported values: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial report (e.g., 'Form 10-Q')")
    balance_sheet_line: str | None = Field(description="Label as written for total assets line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: list[FinancialReport]
